Also in its favour: return on capital employed is 31.9%, a strong return on the money in the business; profit grew 26.9% a year on average over three years; and profit grew 42% compared with a year earlier. Other areas on this side: growth, the balance sheet, the quality of the business.
prose.against: The case against rests mostly on the recent price trend: the share price is 5.4% lower than a year ago. Also against it: over the past year the share did 5.2 percentage points worse than the Nifty 50; and the 3-year maximum drawdown was -43.6%, a deep fall. Other areas on this side: price behaviour.
prose.weighing: Weighing them: 12 points in favour and 3 against give more points in favour. The pool score is 69 of 100. The side that carries most weight is cash flow and the balance sheet. That gives an educational rating of Buy with high confidence. This is a rule-based reading of the evidence above, not a prediction.
